notes: Build009: Gameplay stays on the field. Defense choices can no longer disappear behind a selected hand card or filter. Exhausted Characters turn sideways. The overlapping hand fits without scrolling. Choose face-up or Hidden when placing a Character. Activation windows show a yellow alert that docks after one second, glowing legal cards and green Skip. The small top gear opens development commands only on request. Card-only hold previews, offline AI and automatic collection sync are retained.
